questions.question: In machine learning, what is the task of predicting discrete category labels called?
What are common unsupervised learning tasks?
In supervised learning, what is the task called when labels are continuous values?
What is the phenomenon called when a model learns training data too well but performs poorly on new data?
Does a Decision Tree belong to supervised learning or unsupervised learning?
Under which learning paradigm is Principal Component Analysis (PCA) typically used?
What is the relationship between Gradient Descent and the Loss Function?
questions.answer: Gradient Descent optimizes model parameters by minimizing the Loss Function

questions.question: What is the relationship between Cross Validation and Overfitting?
questions.answer: Cross Validation is used to detect and prevent overfitting

questions.question: Describe the main differences between supervised and unsupervised learning, and give one typical algorithm for each.
questions.answer: Supervised learning uses labeled data to train models, typical algorithms include Decision Tree and SVM; Unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data, typical algorithms include K-means clustering and PCA

questions.question: Why is feature engineering important in a machine learning project? How does it relate to model performance?
questions.answer: Feature engineering improves model input quality through feature selection, extraction, and transformation. Good feature engineering can significantly improve model performance and generalization ability
